rubric_content.text_property: The finished master matches the brand asset bank (voice: calm, candid, anti-hype; palette and lockups from the canon) rather than generic launch creative, and would pass the studio's Brand-Fidelity bar.

rubrics.description: Brand-fidelity track: the studio rejects a master that drifts off the company's own brand canon.

rubric_content.text_property: The master makes only claims the brief authorised, respects rights/trademark, and carries no deceptive or unsubstantiated superiority claims — it is something the fail-closed compliance gate would explicitly clear.

rubrics.description: Compliance track: a fail-closed gate must explicitly clear the master; unauthorised or unprovable claims must be blocked, not shipped.
